verdicts.title: Chaotic Delone sets
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We present a definition of chaotic Delone set, and establish the genericity of chaos in the space of $(ε,δ)$-Delone sets for $ε\geq δ$. We also present a hyperbolic analogue of the cut-and-project method that naturally produces examples of chaotic Delone sets.
